title: 英語リーディング　情報の検索と要旨把握
subtitle: 試験対策｜広告・掲示の読み取り・事実と意見の区別・論説文の要旨
subject: english
instructions: 大学入学共通テストの出題形式を参考にしたオリジナル問題です。
選択肢は番号で答えなさい。

stimuli.content:
Midori City Library — New E-book App!
・Free for all city residents (library card required)
・Borrow up to 5 e-books at once
・Loan period: 2 weeks (can be renewed once)
・Books are returned automatically on the due date — no late fees!
stimuli.title: Advertisement

stimuli.content:
Should libraries replace paper books with e-books? In a recent survey of 500 high school students, over 60% of the respondents said they read e-books on their phones. E-books are convenient: you can carry hundreds of them in one device.

However, paper books still have strengths. Some readers say it is easier to remember what they read on paper, and many people simply enjoy turning pages.

Rather than choosing one, libraries should offer both. That way, every reader can choose the style that suits them best.
